Hamdan bin Mohammed: Dubai Chambers is leading Dubai’s largest business delegation to China for the “Dubai Business Forum - China” in Shenzhen on 14 October. In 1990, China was Dubai’s 6th largest trading partner, with non oil trade worth AED 2.1 billion. By 2025, non oil trade had reached AED 363.5 billion, a 172 fold increase in 35 years, making China Dubai’s largest trading partner globally. From the Silk Road to the age of AI, Dubai and China continue to build on a partnership driven by trust, ambition and a shared vision for the future.
